dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where are you rushing off to?

dialogues.speaker: Jalo
dialogues.text: I'm here to... Uhh, help out. There's not much I can do, but I'll try my best. I've also grown taller lately, and I'll definitely keep growing.

dialogues.speaker: Jalo
dialogues.text: Once I'm all grown up, I can help out like the adults. And when I do more of that, I can get more Mora...
